Refund and cancellation policy

Effective 2026-10-20

This policy explains how to cancel your KeyHelm subscription and when we give refunds. It is part of our Terms of service.

How to cancel

Sign in, open Settings, and choose Manage billing to cancel. You can also email admin@keyhelm.app from the email address on your account and say you want to cancel. We will confirm by email.

Month-to-month plans

  • You can cancel at any time. Your cancellation takes effect at the end of the month you have already paid for, and you will not be charged again.
  • We do not give partial refunds for the unused part of a month.

12-month agreements

Ending a 12-month agreement early

You can end a 12-month agreement early at any time. Service continues to the end of the month you have already paid for. We then charge a one-time amount equal to the difference between the month-to-month price and your agreement price, for the months you have already used. That way you never pay more than month-to-month would have cost you for the same months. No other early-cancellation fee applies.

After the first 12 months, the agreement continues month to month at the agreement price, and you can cancel any time with no extra charge.

When we refund

  • If we charged you by mistake, such as a duplicate charge or the wrong number of doors, we refund the difference.
  • If the service was unavailable for a long period because of a problem on our side, contact us and we will work out a fair credit or refund.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method. Your bank may take 5 to 10 business days to show it.

What this policy does not cover

KeyHelm never collects rent, deposits or vendor payments, so we cannot refund them. Questions about those go to your landlord or the vendor.

Email admin@keyhelm.app.
